user.title: Native EZVIZ validation source
user.description: Use an existing private local-credential file and observed PES IDs. No camera is contacted during setup. Audio ID -1 explicitly omits audio. One entry per video track. This is a validation integration; HA and browser support remain to be tested. Optional shared relay uses an operator-managed go2rtc on IPv4 loopback. Leave API port blank for direct delivery. Relay mode permits one native acquisition per entry reload; keep preload off.

data.name: Name
data.credentials_path: Absolute private credential JSON path on HA
data.channel: Known SDK preview channel (not configuration channel)
data.audio_id: Observed AAC PES ID, or -1 for no audio
data.relay_api_port: Optional go2rtc loopback HTTP API port (enables one-shot relay)
